title: Project: Replicated Log with Quorum Replication
summary: Build a replicated append-only log: quorum writes, leader election with terms, commit-index safety and convergence after a partition heals.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: quorum arithmetic, term monotonicity, commit safety, log convergence and restart durability.

rubric.label: Safety
rubric.description: No committed entry is ever lost or overwritten, and no two leaders ever hold a quorum in the same term.
